doctrines.note: Veterancy: Top Line. GAP: no fight-type Strength ratings block, Hero pairing, or Counters — OP left literal X placeholders for all of these; not fabricated here. Example build per OP: Epic Polearm Doctrine (Pike Charge), Unit Damage Doctrine V, Anti-Cavalry Doctrine (-40% cav dmg bracing), Epic Polearm Doctrine (+80 piercing dmg, +120 piercing AP), Anti-Cavalry Doctrine (lower tier, -30%) or Epic Bloodthirsty Doctrine. Per OP: Pike Charge is pretty good to counter divers and re-brace after; replace Pike Charge with Epic Leadership Doctrine if you don't like it, or with another piercing dmg doctrine; replace piercing dmg or Pike Charge with Epic Bloodthirsty Doctrine if sustain is needed. Playstyle: always play in F1 (very rare case where F2 works if heavily covered); use long range to be behind Spartan / with phalanx and add heavy anti-cav while still adding DPS to the front line; very good field unit. Edit timestamp (2026-05-26) pre-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor; doctrine/build guidance flagged for revalidation (Fortebraccio Pikemen is not on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist, so staleAsOfPatch not forced, noting pre-patch authorship per instructions). 'Tips & Tricks' is also a literal X placeholder in the OP.
